statement: Manic Mode toggles on before entering a tunnel; stamina costs are 30x higher but you get credited a separate Manic Best Depth for the tunnel.
Manic power bonus is multiplied by 1.05 per Manic Depth reached across all tunnels combined, not just the highest; he is at 922 depths.
Manic power bonus is a very strong near-multiplier like over spin; his power rose from about 2e33 to 1e35 mostly from this alone.
Manic efficiency is very strong and will be great once he returns to page farming.
Manic efficiency bonus also scales by 1.05 per manic depth across all tunnels, giving 2543%, a strong near-multiplier.
Elixir memorization isn't a backup pouch; it uses each memorized elixir once at start of run. Hold an elixir to memorize; up to 3 now, scales to 5.
Double think memory gives a 48% chance of two uses of each memorized elixir at run start; it caps at 100%.
Memorize only elixirs you want at the start of every run, like stamina ones; a memorized grand discovery would nerf the run since normal strategy revolves around gray elixir.
Stamina trackometer fills as stamina is used and levels up; at level 11 he found it gave little stamina and isn't strong.
Trackometer amber upgrade gives 60 amber per level, 660% currently; he doesn't know how strong it is yet.
Maxima track gives plus 5 max stamina per trackometer level, 99 for him; felt like more than the initial trackometer. Not super impressed overall.
Royal hard hats give 22 talent points to royal guardians; good now since few ways exist to get extra points, a low shelf.
Royal hard hats are very expensive in the new purple currency (2.4 per level at 22); he expects to get remaining talent points from a royal guardian upgrade by maxing time.
Paper hard hats give straight research gains and he thinks it is a pretty decent multiplier.
Fire hard hats give 136 total damage; not sure more damage is needed, but not a bad source.
Striking hardhat makes priest units generate 1.46x purity XP so maps purify faster; frontrunners haven't unlocked it, strength unknown but looks like a direct multiplier.
Final column pink amber node condenses amber; the color looks purple to him.
Pink amber node is worth 1K red amber or 1e24 orange amber each; decent to put a few points in but don't focus on it.
Amber supply swamp makes amber worth 25x but drops 20x less often; good to put a point in since overall amber increases.
New cavern power requirements are huge and scale hard: barrier rope E32, marble urn E34 unbroken, holy visage E35s, final node E38 starting power.
After optimizing manic mode he expects about 5e35, then 1e36 with more optimization, and 1e37 with elixirs, maybe one try at the final node.
He is hitting most power requirements across mechanics and doubts there is enough power to do significant damage in the new cavern.
New cavern is horrendous for amber: with 36 over stem he got nearly 7,000 of new currency, worse than Bizzario and Lunar Isle, better than old triplet.
Don't add the new cavern to your amber rotation; run it only for the boss bonus.
Boss bonus gives 1.5x chance for marble drops on royal guardians (low base chance) and plus 50 royal guardian talent points; solid get.
Boss clear needs roughly 1e33 power, maybe about 5e32 at the lowest; he overkilled. Boss is very tanky.
Upgrade critical impact, which deals more damage to objects and the boss in this case.
Do manic mode first before the boss since it gives extra power and lets you get deeper.
He plans a best-depth run around Skull Post, currently at 329, and thinks he can do the same on Exile Throne.
Manic mode's 30x stamina cost means characters won't get deep, so a dedicated setup is needed.
Pulse setup: memorize stamina elixirs (yellow, blue, purple) and run five Nova elixirs. Send one guy in, go as far as stamina allows.
Use the smallest hammer in manic mode; clicking a corner hits two nodes at once, up to four with the second hammer, improving stamina efficiency.
He sent one guy in week one for lack of stamina; long term spend all stamina on as many characters as possible for max depth.
After the last character runs out of stamina, pop Nova elixirs; stamina got 40-60 depth, Nova elixirs added 60-80 more floors.
On multiples of five floors spend extra time to find the elixir or hole; worth it because he has about 60-70% elixir return chance.
Strategy: memorize elixirs, one guy in week one then full roster, take full Nova setup, click one at a time and descend; only depth matters.
Kill the boss in manic mode because the upgrade gives roughly three extra elixirs.
Grand discoveries are super easy now; at overflow chance he got two grand discoveries from one node.
Grind grand discoveries: very easy now and valuable for amber, pal and spelunking experience.
He is top of the pal leaderboard, winning grand discoveries, and third in amber.
He sacrificed his 36 over stem for content; amber on Exile Throne is not worth it.
Amber hordes makes all spelunking shop upgrades cheaper per total royal statue level; strong, use before upgrading, needs royal guardian progress.
Spelunking specialty gives max stamina (additive, nearly nothing) and XP multiplier; level it only for XP, not stamina.
Peter Pages talent gives roughly 5-6x true multiplier on pages efficiency and speed for all characters; best of the new talents, can't be super talented.
Grand Vain gives 1.05x grand discovery chance in spelunking for all characters; multiplier stacks, great if struggling with grand discoveries.
Pulse team strategy is five Nova Blast elixirs; being tested with other endgame players.
Blikter's group runs stamina elixirs (yellow blue, triple shadow) with hammer two; pulse team used hammer one; unsure which is best.
Shadow strike with hammer two likely better due to stronger splash; true meta likely between Blikter's and pulse's setups.
In laser caverns stamina will be plentiful so both strategies reach similar depth before RNG; low-stamina players may prefer pulse's, mid game shadow strike.
For endgame he is unsure which strategy is best and is still testing.
